---
title: "Toolkit"
---

<style>
.toolkit-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
  column-gap: 40px;
  row-gap: 30px;
  width: 100%;
}

.toolkit-box { min-width: 0; }
.toolkit-box h3 { margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 20px; }
.toolkit-box ul { margin-top: 0; padding-left: 20px; }
.toolkit-box li { margin-bottom: 7px; }
.toolkit-box a { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .toolkit-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}
@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .toolkit-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .toolkit-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
}
</style>

<div class="toolkit-grid">
